lines.trans: How did your stomach trouble get so severe?
It is an old ailment.
How long have you had it?
Three years—it is fine.
Kaiwen and Xingzi always hide trouble from me; you just joined, so do not pick up that bad habit.
What actually happened at the office?
Nothing at all—I was just worried about you, so I came by to see you.
My mum's stomach-soothing porridge tastes wonderful; I can make it for you—would you like some?
I have seen the lunches you bring to the office every day.
I had admin add an extra meal voucher for you—eat lunch in the staff canteen from now on.
And in the evening you had better avoid eating your own cooking.
Unless you want a stomach like mine, either practise your cooking properly or stay out of the kitchen.
